criteria.requirement: Add records.merge_feeds(previous,incoming,*,partial=False) using the delivered explicit entry_identity. Return {result,changes:{added,updated,unchanged,retained}} with incoming order first and previous absent entries retained in old order; absence never deletes. Inputs and nested output are detached. Duplicate identities within either batch raise. Full mode replaces same-id content, partial mode overlays only supplied top-level fields; report actual data changes even if date strings move backward, without guessed conflict winners. Current non-entry metadata overlays prior metadata, and no network fetch or original result mutation occurs.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
